detail: The unchanged published OpenAPI declares https://api.catsone.com with /webhooks and other unprefixed paths. Its own Host description and current provider docs require https://api.catsone.com/v3. The updated harness reproduces both trigger registration failures before it can validate registration or cleanup. Documented event delivery, signature, filtering, payload hooks, field reads and agent-event checks pass, but neither trigger has a passing conformance verdict. Native lifecycle tests do not satisfy that merge gate. An unauthenticated GET probe returned 404 at /webhooks and 401 at /v3/webhooks; removing /v3 is not a valid node fix. The harness only supports server_url for absent/relative/empty whole-URL servers; it cannot bind this fixed absolute server to the documented v3 base. A provider-corrected published pin or upstream, source-linked catalog server-base override is required; changing the pinned bytes or shared harness is outside this integration-only task.
required_upstream_change: Support a source-linked catalog override for this documented fixed-server base-path defect, or supply a corrected provider-authored OpenAPI pin.
